LIST rn, y, p FROM Driver has DriverForename: 'Lewis' AND ALSO has DriverSurname: 'Hamilton' AND ALSO is of Result res has Race has RaceName rn AND ALSO res has Race has Season has SeasonYear y AND ALSO res has Race has RaceRound rd AND ALSO res has ResultPoints p ORDERED WITH y ASCENDING, rd ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
